title: Rational Base Descent: A Deterministic Algorithm for Factoring Structured Semiprimes
summary: We present a special-purpose algorithm for factoring semiprimes $N = pq$ in which one prime factor satisfies $p \approx c\,(a/b)^n$ for positive integers $a, b, c, n$ with $a > b$ and $\gcd(a,b) = 1$. Given the correct parameters $(a, b)$, the algorithm isolates a factor in ${O}(\log^3 N)$ time when $a/b$ is bounded away from $1$, and the cofactor $q$ is unconstrained beyond a mild size bound.
